reason: The cited evidence shows HEAs can catalyze 12-electron ethanol oxidation (E1) and that multi-metal interactions tune binding strengths (E2), but neither passage provides any support for the key premises about oxidative pretreatment inducing Pt-rich surface restructuring, the specific electronic coupling mechanism, or how this would optimize intermediate adsorption energies.
premises: HEA surfaces can restructure to form Pt-rich domains under oxidative conditions
Pt-rich domains electronically coupled with promoter metals (Ru, Ni, Co) adjust d-band properties
Adjusted d-band properties yield optimal adsorption energies for ethanol oxidation intermediates
Optimal adsorption energies facilitate complete 12-electron/proton transfer and reduce poisoning
